title: Polynomial time is contained in nondeterministic polynomial time
statement: Every language in $\mathsf{P}$ belongs to $\mathsf{NP}$, where membership in $\mathsf{NP}$ means that there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a verifier language $V\in\mathsf{P}$ such that, for each binary string $x$, membership of $x$ is equivalent to the existence of a binary certificate $u$ of length exactly $C(|x|+1)^c$ for which the concatenation $xu$ belongs to $V$.
replaced:
Every language $L \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ decidable in polynomial time belongs to
$\mathsf{NP}$; that is, for every $L \in \mathsf{P}$ there exist
$C, c \in \mathbb{N}$ and a language $V \in \mathsf{P}$ such that for every binary
string $x$, $x \in L$ if and only if some $u \in \{0,1\}^{*}$ with
$|u| = C \cdot (|x|+1)^c$ has $xu \in V$.
